question: Within a 100 kilometers distance, where can I find a fast food restaurant on the path toward Giant Wheel at Irvine Spectrum Center, Irvine, CA from Alta Vista Gardens, Vista, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.219371 33.210166)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.742558 33.649409)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.219371 33.210166)',4326)::geography, 100000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.219371 33.210166)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
